plan.notes: Per the 2026-2028 UT Austin undergraduate catalog: Asian Studies, South Asia (BA), Total Hours Required: 120. The catalog states the Plan of Study is a suggested four-year course sequence to support academic planning; currently enrolled students should meet with their academic advisor to tailor course selections. Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
